alternatives_rejected.why: Its own span self-time is unchanged (0.2->0.2ms, 0.99x). Only inbound calls from checkoutservice slowed, so its high p90 in E1 is caller-observed latency from checkoutservice (E2).
It is one of 6 callees that slowed only on calls from checkoutservice (E3), so its p90 rise in E1 reflects checkoutservice's network delay rather than its own fault.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect checkoutservice's pod network, such as tc/netem qdisc rules, sidecar or network policy, and node NIC. Remove any injected latency rule or reschedule checkoutservice to a healthy node, then confirm checkoutservice p50/p90 and inbound latency return to baseline.
